snippet.title: Destroy All Humans! - Crypto-137 Edition Trailer
snippet.description:
Destroy All Humans! is OUT NOW on PC, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One.

The Crypto-137 Edition features:
- a Crypto-137 figurine
- a Crypto backpack
- keychain
- six lithographs, 
- anti-stress/eye-popping toy
- all in-game Crypto skins
- contained within a premium box

SRP of €399.99 | $399.99 | £349.99 = approximately amounting to seven tons of mutilated cow corpse juice’s worth of Crypto currency.
#DestroyAllHumans #WorldDominationTour
